_comment: Copy this file to firebase.config.json in the same directory and fill in your own values.
firebase.config.json is gitignored: it identifies YOUR Firebase project, and a fork should use its own.
See docs/FIREBASE_SETUP.md for where each value comes from.
None of these are secrets. A Firebase web apiKey and an OAuth clientId are public identifiers —
they appear in every shipped client and are meant to. What protects the project is the Firebase
security rules and the fact that this OAuth client can only redirect to loopback addresses.
clientSecret is optional: Google issues one for 'Desktop app' clients and explicitly does not
treat it as confidential, and this app uses PKCE instead, so leaving it empty is fine.
Gosset also reads GOSSET_FIREBASE_API_KEY / _CLIENT_ID / _CLIENT_SECRET / _PROJECT_ID from the
environment, which is how a CI build can configure itself without a file.
